basic:
Use case: strict identity-preserving game pixel-sprite emotion sheet. Reference 1 is Luna's ORIGINAL in-game miniature and is the authority for pixel style, silhouette and head/body ratio. Reference 2 is her approved full-length adult portrait and is the authority for outfit, hair, accessories and mature personality. This is Luna, a 25-year-old adult woman, blonde cat ears/tail, very long curled golden-blonde hair, black bows with gold heart ornaments, fitted black-and-white checked dress/corset with original white trim, dark stockings/shoes as in miniature, gold heart jewelry, small black quilted handbag held in her hand on the VIEWER'S LEFT. Preserve these features and handbag in EVERY cell. Do not introduce Moku's cigarette, beer, black hair or sloppy clothes. Do not change the outfit, add nudity, infantilize, or turn her into a younger innocent schoolgirl. Keep original narrow expressive eyes/eyeliner and adult confident smile, not glossy huge doll eyes. Match the original miniature's exact proportions, with expressions and gestures readable at small game size. Crisp clustered pixel art, not soft painterly texture.

Make exactly 4 columns x 2 rows, eight equal cells on a truly transparent RGBA background. One complete full-body Luna per cell, ALL same scale and identity. Feet centered on a consistent baseline; generous empty margins, hair, handbag, hands, tail and ears fully within each cell, no overlap. No background color, gradients, glows, shadows, floating hearts, icons, labels, grid, effects or text. Use the free hand for gestures; handbag-holding hand always holds the bag. Exactly two arms.
Row 1 left to right: 1 HAPPY: warm adult smile, relaxed open free palm. 2 ANGRY: narrowed annoyed eyes, free hand on hip, ears angled back, tail tense. 3 SAD: subdued downcast face, shoulders drooped, free hand loose, ears and tail low. 4 SURPRISED: brows lifted, eyes moderately wider, free hand raised briefly near shoulder, small recoil. Row 2: 5 CONFUSED: skeptical head tilt, one brow lifted, free hand at cheek. 6 SCARED: recoils slightly with knees bent, ears flattened, free hand close to collarbone, worried eyes. 7 RELIEVED: faint tired smile, gentle closed eyelids, free hand rests on chest, shoulders relax. 8 SHY: adult awkward embarrassment, slight blush, eyes glance aside, free fingers touch hair, no childlike clasped hands.

Row 2: 5 STUNNED DISBELIEF: frozen upright stance, eyes wide, free hand to mouth, ears rigid, handbag still held at her side. 6 LAUGHING: adult amused confident laugh, eyes closed in smiling arcs, free hand covers smile lightly, torso relaxed with small sideways lean. 7 FLIRT / INVITING WINK: confidently winks one eye, mature knowing smile, free index finger makes a small 'come here' beckoning gesture, hip shifted gently, poised hostess営業smile, handbag held at side. 8 FLIRT / COAXING LEAN: BOTH eyes half-lidded with direct warm gaze, torso leaning slightly toward viewer, free fingertip near cheek/lips and head tilted invitingly, soft teasing smile, tail curls elegantly, affectionate coaxing hostess manner. repair: Precise local correction of ONLY row 2 column 2 (bottom row second cell) of this eight-sprite Luna sheet. That frightened Luna currently has both hands together at her chest and is missing her black handbag. Preserve her worried face, crouching/recoiling body, hair, ears, tail and dress. Keep just ONE free hand close to her collarbone, and lower the other arm on the VIEWER'S LEFT so that its hand clearly holds the SAME small black quilted handbag with gold heart charms as the other seven sprites, next to her hip. Exactly two arms and two hands. Bag must be fully visible inside her cell. Preserve ALL other seven sprites, their pixels, expressions, cell arrangement, scale, colors, original adult identity and transparency. No extra props, text, backgrounds, glows or shadows.
backgroundCleanup: BACKGROUND EXTRACTION ONLY. The attached image is a 4 columns by 2 rows game sprite sheet with eight Luna sprites. Its transparent background is imperfect: there are brown/gray/black translucent gradient clouds and rectangular matte halos around the figures. Remove ALL those background clouds, dark glows and translucent backplates so every empty pixel between and around the sprites is truly transparent. Make a clean alpha silhouette immediately around hair strands, ears, arms, legs, shoes, tail, handbag and ornaments. No shadows or glows outside the character silhouette. Keep the actual eight characters and EVERY outfit detail, face, handbag, pose, pixel colors, style, size, location, grid layout and the canvas dimensions unchanged. Do NOT redraw, redesign, change expressions or move any sprites. Retain fine golden hair and black bows/shoes/handbag; do not mistake dark clothing for background. Preserve all eight full bodies and all accessories exactly. Output a genuinely transparent RGBA sprite sheet ready to composite cleanly over a LIGHT cream background, with no gray box or smoky haze. No added background, text, grids or labels.

Not enormous round child/doll eyes. Preserve each emotion using eyebrows, gaze direction and mouth. Do not change the outfit, hair, bags, jewelry, body poses, hands, tail, ears, colors, pixel style, cell positions or scale. Every sprite must retain her black quilted handbag. Row2: confused BOTH eyes open and skeptical; scared BOTH eyes open; relieved eyes CLOSED softly (this is the only closed-eye sprite on this sheet); shy BOTH eyes open glancing sideways with slight blush.
